verdict.rationale: Plausible's own scheduling is limited to recurring email reports (weekly or monthly) and Slack reports, which run on a recurring schedule rather than as one-off actions. It offers no general way to define or schedule arbitrary jobs or workflows. The Stats API is read-only and on-demand, with no scheduler. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring jobs or workflows beyond fixed report digests, configurable schedules or cron-style triggers, programmatic or API-based schedule management, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Email reports: scheduled reports delivered to your inbox
Get weekly or monthly reports via email or Slack, including traffic spike/drop notifications.
Slack reports: send reports to a Slack channel
